classification: sampled CPU pilot; design evidence only; not formal evidence

source_experiment.role: strong static comparator identity only; source outcomes are forbidden controller inputs

actions.catalogue: local plus each of three single donors at each registered nonzero alpha

probe.selection_rule: minimize squared distance from candidate model to the selection-half recipient fingerprint
probe.screen_rule: accept only when validation-half empirical squared loss is no larger than the same-data local shadow

analysis.primary_metric: cell-mean personalized parameter MSE averaged over 24 blocks
analysis.strong_static_graph: frozen T-070A exact best static graph, simulated with all 240 transitions as learning updates

mandatory_gates.S1: all trajectories are finite, use exactly 240 environment transitions, at most 18 message units, and exactly 168 candidate scores
mandatory_gates.S2: complete coverage of 432 cells, 32 seeds, and 13824 endpoints
mandatory_gates.S3: observable controller improves aggregate geometric cumulative risk over the strong static graph by at least 5% on nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.S4: observable controller strictly improves at least 55% of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.S5: observable controller improves both nonstationary schedule families by at least 2%
mandatory_gates.S6: observable controller has nonnegative aggregate improvement in every delay group
mandatory_gates.S7: observable controller is no worse than its charged shadow in aggregate and has ratio at most 1.05 in at least 90% of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.S8: observable controller CVaR90 geometric ratio to strong static is at most 0.97
mandatory_gates.S9: observable controller captures at least 35% of the charged clairvoyant oracle improvement over strong static
mandatory_gates.S10: the observable graph changes at at least 60% of registered schedule-change boundaries
mandatory_gates.S11: stationary-control observable-to-static geometric ratio is at most 1.10
